mapper.select: SELECT p.ad_position_id, p.ad_position_code, p.ad_location, p.single_side_area, p.total_ad_area, p.ad_specification, p.longitude, p.latitude, p.district, p.road_name, p.remark, p.version, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_ad_lease_detail l WHERE l.ad_position_code=p.ad_position_code AND l.deleted=0 AND l.approval_status='APPROVED' AND CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN l.lease_start_date AND l.lease_end_date) THEN 'leased' ELSE 'vacant' END AS status FROM t_ad_position p ORDER BY p.ad_position_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT p.ad_position_id, p.ad_position_code, p.ad_location, p.single_side_area, p.total_ad_area, p.ad_specification, p.longitude, p.latitude, p.district, p.road_name, p.remark, p.version, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_ad_lease_detail l WHERE l.ad_position_code=p.ad_position_code AND l.deleted=0 AND l.approval_status='APPROVED' AND CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN l.lease_start_date AND l.lease_end_date) THEN 'leased' ELSE 'vacant' END AS status FROM t_ad_position p WHERE p.ad_position_code=#{code} AND p.deleted=0

SELECT p.ad_position_id, p.ad_position_code, p.ad_location, p.single_side_area, p.total_ad_area, p.ad_specification, p.longitude, p.latitude, p.district, p.road_name, p.remark, p.version, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_ad_lease_detail l WHERE l.ad_position_code=p.ad_position_code AND l.deleted=0 AND l.approval_status='APPROVED' AND CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN l.lease_start_date AND l.lease_end_date) THEN 'leased' ELSE 'vacant' END AS status FROM t_ad_position p WHERE p.ad_position_code=#{code} AND p.deleted=0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ad_position (ad_position_code, ad_location, single_side_area, total_ad_area, ad_specification, longitude, latitude, district, road_name, status, remark) VALUES (#{adPositionCode}, #{adLocation}, #{singleSideArea}, #{totalAdArea}, #{adSpecification}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{district}, #{roadName}, #{status}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ad_position SET ad_location=#{position.adLocation}, single_side_area=#{position.singleSideArea}, total_ad_area=#{position.totalAdArea}, ad_specification=#{position.adSpecification}, longitude=#{position.longitude}, latitude=#{position.latitude}, district=#{position.district}, road_name=#{position.roadName}, status=#{position.status}, remark=#{position.remark}, version=version+1 WHERE ad_position_code=#{code} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_ad_lease_detail WHERE ad_position_code=#{code} AND deleted=0 AND ( approval_status IN ('DRAFT', 'PENDING', 'REJECTED') OR (approval_status='APPROVED' AND lease_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE) )
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ad_position SET deleted=1, version=version+1 WHERE ad_position_code=#{code} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT valuation_id, ad_position_code, ad_location, single_side_area, total_ad_area, ad_specification, ad_count, discounted_rent, total_assessed_value, valuation_date, lessee_company, valuation_method FROM t_ad_position_valuation WHERE ad_position_code=#{code} ORDER BY valuation_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ad_lease_id, contract_code, ad_position_code, ad_location, single_side_area, total_ad_area, ad_specification, lessee_code, lessee_company, lease_rent, lease_term, lease_start_date, lease_end_date, contract_sign_date, version, 0 AS attachment_count, approval_status, submitted_by_username, submitted_at, approver_username, approved_at, approval_comment FROM t_ad_lease_detail WHERE ad_position_code=#{code} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY lease_start_date DESC
